title: What Leading a Woman Actually Looks Like (It's Not Control)
caption:
Control says do what I say. Leadership says I'll go first, and I'll pay for it. If you're dating or married, or just want to be the man worth marrying, start with the four.

Send it to a brother who's learning this.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
